title: Wolf-Winter census search is within 2.4% of its state cap
body:
Wolf-Winter's census proofs are close to their state cap. From the plain start the exhaustive search now explores 390,287 states against MAX_STATES = 400,000 in the census proofs (about 2.4% headroom); the test comment still records 315,100 (measured 2026-07-14). The next Wolf-Winter content change that adds reachable state can trip the cap and turn the nightly deep audit red for a reason unrelated to correctness.

Re-measure, update the recorded counts, and decide on headroom deliberately (the cap backstop is a protected file; raising it is a conscious verifier edit, not a weakening of what the proof checks).

Audit report: https://claude.ai/artifact/SD45nGH1YqftoSvkxL8Hbb (2026-09-22, main c17192f9).
